successes.item: Maintained exercise consistency with six bike sessions.
Made significant progress on the AI Native Diploma platform.

failures.item: Learning volume was significantly below target.
Training consistency suffered due to lack of fallback plans.

insights.item: Learning sessions must be small and daily.
The final 10% of work creates most of the value.
Sleep and recovery are the primary bottlenecks.
Having a schedule reduces decision fatigue.
